title: Add icon to st.header and st.subheader (and st.markdown?)
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Add `icon=` to some Markdown primitives just like other primitives `st.button`, `st.expander`

### Why?

It's rather typical to have icons or emojis in page titles. But they don't look very nice or aligned.
Making a dedicated argument could help us position the icon better!

### How?

_No response_
